CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Forward flight speed through the tunnel.
CONTROLS.NAME: fly_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Speed of the colour shift across the goo surface. 0 = static colour.
CONTROLS.NAME: colour_speed

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Temporal blur — blends current frame with previous. Higher = smoother, more trails.
CONTROLS.NAME: motion_blur

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Controls how quickly distant blobs fade to black. Lower = clearer distance, higher = heavier fog.
CONTROLS.NAME: fog_density

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Strength of brightness pulse on bass hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_reactivity

CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Strength of water-ripple effect on the goo surface triggered by bass hits.
CONTROLS.NAME: bass_ripple

DESCRIPTION: Fly through a gooey bioluminescent tunnel carved from noise. Original shader by Kamil Kolaczynski (CC-BY-NC-SA 3.0). Flight mechanics from Remnant Planet.
TITLE: Goo
